prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: WIP background concept for a 320x224 Mega Drive splash screen, to be translated into indexed tile art later. Primary request: Create a vivid, premium 16-bit era technology reveal backdrop with crystalline energy rushing inward toward a large empty center where separate SGDK lettering will be placed later. It should feel animated, adventurous, and energized even as a single still image. Scene/backdrop: Deep midnight blue void with an energetic field of angular crystal shards and short directional streaks sweeping diagonally from the outer edges toward the center. Keep the central 45 percent mostly dark and unobstructed for a large wordmark. Make the corners and side edges feel alive and asymmetrical; use varied shard sizes and clear gaps so individual shapes read. Style/medium: Refined late-16-bit game intro concept art, crisp hard-edged faceted shapes, deliberate graphic clusters, readable at 320x224 after reduction; more like a designed game splash than a continuous gradient or generic nebula. Composition/framing: Wide console screen composition, centered negative-space well, asymmetrical crystal framing, directional movement converging on the central zone, lower center left open for a smaller secondary wordmark. Lighting/mood: Bright crystalline flashes and short sharp glints, sense of discovery, confidence, and forward motion; restrained bloom, no fog blanket. Color palette: Midnight navy, cobalt, saturated cyan, ice blue, with a few small near-white glints; high contrast with clear dark separation. Constraints: No text, no letters, no logos, no icons, no interface, no border, no characters. Preserve open negative space in the center. This is a concept source only, not final pixel art. Avoid: Smooth continuous monochrome gradients, circular portal, generic starfield, dense noise, long soft light trails, photographic rendering, tiny indistinct particles, overexposed center, watermark.
review: Independent concept source; energetic edge framing and protected central negative space look promising at source size. High-resolution detail remains unvalidated at 320x224. Translation, native tile review, ROM review, and human art approval remain pending.
